slides.title: If your website were a grocery store.

slides.label: FRONTEND
slides.title: Frontend is the shop floor.
slides.body: Clean shelves, clear prices, easy to find. Everything your customers see and touch.

slides.label: BACKEND
slides.title: Backend is the stockroom.
slides.body: Nobody sees it, but it's where every order is packed and every product is kept in check.

slides.label: API
slides.title: The API is the runner.
slides.body: Carries requests from the shop floor to the stockroom and brings back exactly what was asked for.

slides.label: DATABASE
slides.title: The database is the warehouse.
slides.body: Every product labeled, counted and in its place, so anything can be found in seconds.

slides.label: AUTHENTICATION
slides.title: Authentication is the badge check.
slides.body: Staff-only doors stay staff-only. No badge, no entry.

slides.label: FULL-STACK
slides.title: Full-stack is the owner on a busy day.
slides.body: Till, shelves and stockroom at the same time, and still smiling.

slides.label: PROJECT MANAGER
slides.title: The PM is the store manager.
slides.body: Tasks, stock and people on one tablet. The doors open on time.

slides.label: QA TESTING
slides.title: QA is the quality check.
slides.body: Expiry, packaging, price and quality, one by one, before anything reaches the shelf.

slides.label: BUG FIXING
slides.title: Bug fixing is the cleanup crew.
slides.body: A shelf breaks, something spills. We fix it before customers even notice.

slides.label: DEPLOYMENT
slides.title: Deployment is opening day.
slides.body: Doors open, team ready, first customers in. Your website is live.

slides.title: We build the whole store.
slides.body: Shop floor to stockroom: design, development and launch, all in one place.
